Name: Ran's Fancy Farmer
Author: ranfuu
Description:
Update version 1.2.5
[b]
FEATURES:
[/b]- Long sleeves, affects all shirts
- 2 new pairs of pants for female + re-sprite of default pants
- 2 new pairs of pants for male
- 2 new shoe styles for both farmers
- Removes horse reins
- [Optional] Swimsuits by Delt9T (replace "female_bottoms.png" and "male_bottoms.png" in main file)

[b]REQUIREMENTS:[/b]
- SMAPI
- Kisekae
[b]
INSTALL:[/b]
- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Kisekae
- Download and unzip files
- Place "overrides" folder in "\Stardew Valley\Mods\Kisekae"
- Let it replace the files
- Open Kisekae’s config.json and edit the following lines:
"MaleBottomsTypes": 8,
"MaleShoeTypes": 4,
"FemaleBottomsTypes": 15,
"FemaleShoeTypes": 6,
[b]
NOTES:[/b]
- GetDressed/Kisekae’s original style options are available along with this mod’s new additions but make sure to edit the config for it to work properly

[b]CREDIT:[/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/331]GetDressed creators Jinxiewinxie and Advize[/url] (parts of original bottom sets already included in GetDressed by [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/alex_01.613098/]Alex_01[/url], [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/runenl.69274/]RuneNL[/url], and [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/meevers.616635/]Meevers[/url])
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2348]Kisekae by Kabigon[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/324]Delta's Better Swimsuits by Delt9T[/url] (robe and towel by [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/swimsuits-to-towels-or-robes-update-5-1-16.113721/]Little Lea[/url])
- [url=http://mayorfuu.tumblr.com/]http://mayorfuu.tumblr.com/[/url]

[b]Please do not reupload/redistribute[/b]
